purpose: Define the hard boundary between model-generated text/structured proposals/tool requests and actual canonical AIGMos operations.

owns: Model Output to Operation Boundary semantics

value.request_rule: A model may emit a structured candidate operation/tool request only according to an explicit request schema.
value.resolve_rule: Requested operation/target resolves exact canonical identities.
value.validation_rule: Arguments, schema, capability, bounds and semantic constraints validate before dispatch.
value.authorization_rule: Caller/session AccessCore and assurance requirements are evaluated independently from model recommendation.
value.dispatch_rule: Only the normal governed runtime dispatcher can produce effects.
value.failure_rule: Invalid/unresolved/unauthorized model request remains inert and yields structured failure.
value.chain_rule: Model output cannot recursively execute subsequent output without each effect crossing the same boundary.
